name: Ancient Statuette
summary: The Ancient Statuette is a sunken relic recovered from the shores of the Zoram Strand in northwestern Ashenvale. Sought by the night elf Talen, the small effigy originates from the submerged ruins of the ancient city of Zoram.

sections.title: A Relic in the Shallows
sections.body: The waters off northwestern Ashenvale conceal the sunken remains of Zoram, a pre-Sundering night elven city lost beneath the waves ten thousand years ago. In recent days, the explorer Talen surveyed the submerged ruins from a small craft, seeking lost historical relics. When a vicious assault by naga drove him ashore, Talen abandoned most of his belongings in his flight, dropping the ancient statuette he had dredged up onto the tideline sand near his scuttled skiff.

sections.title: Secrets of Zoram
sections.body: Talen considers the statuette his most prized possession and the entire justification for braving the monster-infested coast. Rather than merely being a piece of decorative stonework, he believes the effigy serves as an essential key to deciphering the architecture, history, and arcane secrets locked away beneath the surf of Zoram Strand.

faq.answer: It is an artifact retrieved from the sunken ruins of the ancient night elven city of Zoram, located off the northwestern coast of Ashenvale.

faq.q: Who is looking for the statuette?
faq.answer: The night elf scholar Talen seeks it. He was skimming over the submerged ruins in a boat when naga ambushed him, causing him to drop the relic on the beach as he fled for his life.
Talen believes the statuette holds the secrets of the ancient city of Zoram and might serve as a key to unraveling the history buried in the ruins beneath the waves.

faq.q: Why are naga prowling around where it was found?
faq.answer: Naga have infested the coastal waters and ruins of the Zoram Strand, aggressively attacking any surface dwellers who venture near the sunken remains of their submerged territory.

angles.text: The statuette is a rare surviving fragment of ancient Kaldorei civilization from before the Great Sundering, preserved for millennia under the sea.
Recovering this artifact assists Talen in documenting and reclaiming night elven heritage from the encroaching naga along Ashenvale's coast.
